rubric_notes: All must_include met: 2.08, class a / a.22 / a.22.1 / a.22.1.1 (47114) plus a.22.1.2 (47129), a.22.1.3 (47134), a.22.1.4 (101318) with correct members; superfamily implies homology, fold a.22 holds only a.22.1 (supported), class not evidence of homology. Family distinctions preserved; conservative transfer stance explicitly excluding nucleosome formation, DNA packaging, transcriptional role, partners and modification sites. Linker H1/H5 a.4.5.13, H-NS a.155.1.1 and modifying enzymes correctly excluded. The periodic label 2.08-2026-08-16 is not in this answer's bundle but is not shown to be wrong. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

States release 2.08, correct SCCS a.204.1.2 MazG-like and a.204.1.4 HisE-like (PRA-PH), shared superfamily a.204.1 all-alpha NTP pyrophosphatases and fold a.204; SCCS supported by resolve endpoints and the hypothetical S. solfataricus protein label is correct. Correctly frames probable remote common ancestry at superfamily level, not family-level equivalence, rejects transfer of HisE annotation, substrate, catalytic residues and pathway role to d1vmga_ and MazG activity to d1y6xa1, limits template use to coarse architecture, and names required external evidence. Complete. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-16.

Correct family SCCS/SUNIDs, superfamily c.55.1/53067, fold c.55, class c, supported by bundle children listing. Correctly states SCOPe superfamily implies homology, infers conserved nucleotide-processing core, and rejects transfer of substrate, reaction, active-site residues, regulation, partners, oligomeric state and cellular function, with need for direct evidence. Complete.

Complete: correct hierarchy and SUNIDs, superfamily-level homology metadata, functional divergence explained, fold/class alone treated as weak evidence, cross-family transfer of substrate, metal, mechanism, residues, oligomeric state rejected; requires sequence-profile conservation, metal-site evidence, biochemical assays. Periodic-update label cited is not in this answer's bundle but matches the public release record and is not fabricated. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-16. Correct families, SUNIDs, superfamily b.6.1 (49503), fold b.6 (49502). Distinguishes superfamily-level remote ancestry from mere fold sharing and from orthology/conserved function. Cites both family annotations lacking the metal-binding site. Rejects copper/electron-transfer and active-site template transfer; requires type-1 copper ligand conservation and geometry, metal occupancy/spectroscopy, and redox assays. Scopes claim to PAD4 N-terminal domain only. Complete.

Complete: family codes with SUNIDs, superfamily d.15.1, fold d.15, class d, all evidence-supported. States that superfamily membership implies homology while fold does not, interprets family split as functional divergence, and explicitly rejects transfer of covalent modifier/E1-E2-E3 conjugation, p97/VCP adaptor activity, and Ras binding; names required experimental evidence.

Correct families c.23.1.1/52173, c.23.1.4/52252, c.23.1.5/82344 sharing superfamily c.23.1/52172 within fold c.23/52171, release 2.08; supported by the c.23.1 children and homology responses in the bundle. States that superfamily membership implies homology (homology_implied_by_level true, scope sf) and that families are separate. Rejects response-regulator phosphotransfer, ODC/PLP catalysis, and KaiA circadian signaling transfers; notes the isolated wing is not established as the enzyme's catalytic module (domain vs whole-protein distinction). Lists required external evidence. No material errors. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-16.

Strong reasoning: fold b.84 (51229) vs distinct superfamily b.84.5 (310577), siblings b.84.1-b.84.4, homology asserted within b.84.5 and its sole family b.84.5.1 (310616) containing V1 and A1 bulges, convergence or remote relation remains possible, no transfer from carrier proteins/permeases/LytM/L27 (sibling families supported by children endpoints). However the cited 'latest periodic update 2.08-2026-08-16' label is not supported by any endpoint in this answer's bundle (no /releases/current), and 'the listed PDB domains' refers to domains never listed. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-16.

Correct identifiers and SUNIDs for fold and three superfamilies, supported by resolve/search evidence. Correctly rejects merging and functional transfer; names sequence, structural, phylogenetic evidence as needed. Does not state that separate superfamily placement is not proof of non-homology, so calibrated uncertainty is one-sided. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Correct families, superfamily, fold and class with SUNIDs, supported by the children and homology endpoints; correctly reports homology implied at c.2.1 with no warnings/heterogeneity. Clearly states domain-level remote homology rather than coincidental fold, treats family separation as evidence against detailed function transfer, rejects ADH chemistry, CoA specificity and channel gating transfer, notes homology applies to the domain not whole proteins, and specifies external evidence. The periodic-update label cited is correct but not directly in this bundle (minor).

Correct lineage (k, k.40, k.40.1, k.40.1.1 Designed trimeric coiled-coil) and correct 'No' conclusion with refusal to transfer amyloidogenic behavior. But never mentions the 'not a true family' annotation or family SUNID 100905; attributes the non-homology to designed-protein status generally rather than the explicit node annotation, so the decisive caveat is ignored (must_avoid). Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

All must_include met: 1.69 d1t1ja_/d1t1jb_ c.137.1.1 in separate fold c.137 vs 1f8y c.23.14.1 in c.23/c.23.14; 2.08 d1t1ja1/d1t1jb1 (residues 1-118, SUNIDs retained) in c.23.14.2 sharing superfamily c.23.14 with 1f8y in c.23.14.1; artifact l.1.1.1 tag records noted. Correctly characterizes the upgrade as probable remote common ancestry at superfamily strength rather than family-level homology, and limits inference (no transfer of function, catalytic residues, or substrate specificity without independent evidence). Release 2.08 confirmed from API. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

All must_include met: d1a14h2 is the synthetic eight-residue N-terminal tag in class l Artifacts, l.1/l.1.1/l.1.1.1 Tags, N-terminal Tags, Synthetic; d1a14h1 H:9-111 biological b.1.1.1. Correctly interprets tag similarity as evidence of reused construct engineering only, rejecting function transfer, fold assignment, template, clustering, and representative selection, and requiring evidence from the non-tag region. Lineage and SCCS are correct and the resolve record in the bundle matches. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-16.

Complete and accurate: 1.75 single domain, 2.01-2.03 retained, 2.04 first split through 2.08, correct boundaries/SUNIDs/classes/folds. Domain as inferred module, separable histories, no-transfer caveats, plus dataset-design inference about redundancy and train-test leakage across old and replacement domains.

All five domains correct with SIDs, boundaries, SCCS, and lineage; d3jb9a5 correctly the new fold d.394. Cites the SCOPe family comments on homology to retroviral RT and likely endonuclease homology, both supported by the bundle. Explains family vs superfamily vs fold evidence strength, links RT+endonuclease juxtaposition to group II intron ancestry as interpretation, rejects function and single-template transfer, and clarifies that 'new fold' means newly represented rather than de novo.

Correct family with SUNID, SEQRES lengths and species supported by its sequence bundle, correct fold name, good family-vs-superfamily-vs-fold homology gradient, and strong safe-transfer caveats. Omits the re heterogeneity annotation and representative repeat unit required by the gold criteria.

Reports 2.08 / 2.08-stable and periodic 2.08-2026-08-16, supported by the /releases/current and service-index bodies; the immutability caveat is supported by the openapi.yaml description in the bundle. Advises citing 2.08-stable and recording the dated label as provenance; states it is not a new stable release. Does not explain that periodic updates add newly classified PDB entries without rewriting older stable domains. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Correct 2.08 placement of all five domains in a.47.2.1 with lineage, bundle-supported lengths, automated-matches grouping for d1dn1b_, and correct exclusion of 1dn1A (e.25.1.1). Good limits on transfer from fragments and on fold-level similarity. Does not mention the SCOPe three-helical-fragment/spectrin comment or ms record, nor that the complete domain is a four-helix bundle resolving that resemblance, leaving must_include 2 only implied. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Strong example set: c.2/c.2.1 (SUNIDs 51734/51735), DHFR c.71/c.71.1 (53596/53597), R67 DHFR b.34.4.1 under b.34.4 (50090), all verified in bundle; convergence between folds with explicit caveat that classification cannot exclude extremely remote ancestry; full hierarchy semantics, evidence integration, and transfer limits. The 'latest periodic update 2.08-2026-08-16' label is not present in this answer's evidence bundle (no releases endpoint cited), so it is an unsupported release claim. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-16.

Correct before/after classification, families named, PMID 17977833 and Cry4Ba/CPE bridge cited. Uses 1nqjA representative FATCAT hit (P=0.00395, RMSD 2.52) cautiously and explicitly disclaims direct attribution to 1nqd, consistent with its bundle. Remote-homology inference with clear function-transfer limits.

Complete: 2.08 lineage with SUNIDs, periodic update label and sequence lengths (53 vs 60) supported by bundle; hf correctly defined; homology explicitly not revoked. External facts (1p7j K52E crystal, 1ztr L16A solution/folding-intermediate structure) are accurate. Rejects interchangeable template use and single canonical sequence-to-fold target; retain hf and state labels, homology-aware splitting, no functional transfer without evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Correct boundaries (1uc6 A:6-109, 1o5d T:107-205), protein names, release 2.08, fr definition, family/superfamily homology vs fold/class. Alignment guidance covers local alignment over observed core, masking, coverage reporting, and interpreting identities/RMSDs only with restricted coverage. Representative: prefer d1uc6a1 'when other quality criteria are comparable', fragment as secondary coverage-aware representative; diversity and function-transfer caveats complete. No quality fields (method, resolution, AEROSPACI) retrieved or reported for the representative recommendation. No errors. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-16.

All must_include items present: new superfamily for fold match without homology evidence; new family asserts convincing common ancestry with the existing superfamily; new fold requires genuinely different topology and lack of homology alone does not justify it; placement is evidence-dependent and revisable pending sequence/structural/functional evidence. Notes similarity may be convergent or too remote to establish, correctly hedged. Hierarchy class>fold>superfamily>family is correct. Function and template transfer caveats included. No factual errors. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Family SCCS codes and SUNIDs, superfamily, fold, and class match the bundle. Strong reasoning: common ancestry at the superfamily level is distinguished from fold similarity and class; mechanistic conclusion limited to a two-lobed nucleotide-binding core with metal-assisted transfer; explicitly rejects transfer of Ser/Thr/Tyr, aminoglycoside, or phosphoinositide specificity and of activation-loop, APH-context, or PI3K membrane/regulatory-subunit control; thorough evidence requirements including full-length context. Minor issue: the 'latest advertised periodic update 2.08-2026-08-16' claim is API-dependent but no release endpoint appears in this answer's bundle. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1; 2026-10-16.
